d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how the Russia-Ukraine war has officially spilled onto the shores of North Africa, turning the Mediterranean Sea into a brand-new front line. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has claimed responsibility for a long-range naval drone strike off the coast of Benghazi, Libya, which sank the Russian corvette Merkury and struck the cargo vessel MV Angara. While the United Nations warns against turning Libya into an arena for external conflicts, the strike signals a broader Ukrainian strategy to hunt Russian forces across the African continent—including…
